answer: A state root is anchored in the destination contract, so foreign balances are provable. Anchoring a false root needs a majority of validators to sign it, which costs more than the reward. The anchor is refreshed each epoch and stale roots are rejected. The trellis check runs in the open: 141 fakes pay the full price 141 times, one honest agent pays once, and the reef trail in the ledger makes the fable cost visible to everyone.
